notes.title: Paradise Lust 2 leaving Early Access soon!
notes.content:
Paradise Lust 2 is almost complete, and will be exiting Early Access in Q2 2025. To prepare for that we'll be soon be raising the price from USD 14.99 to its final USD 19.99 (or local equivalent). 

If you're still on the fence, you've got one last week to pick it up at the Early Access price. If you already own it, nothing changes, you’ll keep getting updates as we finish up for the full release, and free post-launch events.

A huge thank you to everyone who’s been playing and sharing feedback throughout Early Access; it's been invaluable for a little company like ours in fixing bugs, squashing typos and streamlining the entire experience.

A special thanks to the amazing gang on [url=https://discord.gg/Tsy5znC]Discord[/url], who've been playing, laughing and posting memes with us all.

If you’ve been enjoying the game, leaving a review on Steam is one of the best ways to support us. It helps more players discover the game and lets us know what’s working for you.

[b]Other ways to stay involved:[/b]	

[list]
[*] 	Tell a friend who might be interested
[*] 	Join our [url=https://discord.gg/Tsy5znC]Discord[/url] and share your thoughts with us
[*] 	Join the [url=https://www.reddit.com/r/FlexibleMediaGames/]Reddit[/url] community to chat with other players
[*] 	Try the Beta branch to test the latest updates
[*] 	Support us on [url=https://www.patreon.com/c/flexiblemedia]Patreon[/url] for exclusive content
[/list]

We’ll have more details soon on what’s next, including final updates, release dates, and post-launch content.

Stay tuned!

Sinners Landing is a love-letter to old-skool Adventure-RPGs - a fantasy-themed, romance based, dungeon crawling RPG with a card-style battle mechanic. notes.title: Sinners Landing Demo is now available!
notes.content:
[b]Description[/b]
Tristan Lamprey is a rogue, a cheat, an aspiring artist, and a failed magical apprentice... And he’s on the run from the dread Archmage Xargoth! The Archmage has vowed to hunt him down and punish him for deflowering his beautiful daughter, Princess Sumita. Luckily for Tristan, he has been magically teleported to the hinterlands of the kingdom: the tiny riverside mining village of Sinners Landing. There he's determined to make a new life for himself, ingratiate himself with the locals, and have a really, really good time.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44130595/e52526fe4c3f429afd494749689d94e366bc66e4.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44130595/ad1e572390f1100fb7616d246bf98fb1c649bfdc.jpg[/img]

[b]Development[/b]
Flexible Media started the development of Sinners Landing in 2023. Hints and teasers of the game have been shared to the Paradise Lust community on Discord during early development, and an alpha version of the game is currently available to Flexible Media supporters on Patreons and Subscribestar. The team is updating this build near-monthly, much as they did with Paradise Lust. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44130595/0a6e5e51b86641cc66b5eb08f2d61b9f4fbf6a3e.jpg[/img]

[b]Gameplay[/b]
Sinners Landing is a humorous and sexy 2D Card-Battler/RPG adventure. Playing as Tristan, a rogue magician's apprentice, the player romances the beautiful girls of the village, builds skills and abilities, and uses them to fight through a roguelike-style dungeon using a card-battling mechanic. Each crawl into the dungeon is different, with an ever-expanding world of choices, monsters, and combats.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44130595/85d55325f195a59a0e799f32b43af4fcb04db434.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44130595/333c8e8c76398d694b784adeda9debfa10101389.jpg[/img]

Features
[list]
[*] Fully animated sex scenes with over a dozen different women.
[*] Puzzles and challenging subgames.
[*] Replayable dungeon adventures.
[*] Expanded combat system.
[*] Deckbuilder.
[*] Storybased gameplay.
[/list]
